jurisdiction: New York City (resident personal income tax)
type: city resident income tax (withheld via NYS)
rate_resident_pct: graduated; 2026 withholding schedule 2.05% to 4.25% (annual table); supplemental wages 4.25%
rate_nonresident_pct: none withheld (NYS-50 lists NYC residents only)
source_date: NYS-50-T-NYC rev. 1/26 effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 (PDF created 2025-11-03); NYS-50 page updated 2026-08-14; whtax_require undated
note: Employer must withhold NYC tax on all wages of NYC residents even if services performed outside NYC, regardless of length of assignment; employee nonresidence via IT-2104.1. Out-of-state employer with no NY incorporation/license/office/business is not required to withhold (voluntary). Residence by address (Kings, Bronx, New York, Richmond, Queens)

type: city resident surcharge on NYS tax
source_date: NYS-50-T-Y rev. 1/26 effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 (PDF created 2025-11-03); NYS-50 updated 2026-08-14
note: Wages of Yonkers residents subject to surcharge withholding even if work performed outside Yonkers (also certain areas of Bronxville, Scarsdale, Tuckahoe); same out-of-state-employer exception as above

rate_nonresident_pct: 0.50 (supplemental 0.50%); no withholding if annualized pay under $4,000
note: Withheld on wages paid to Yonkers nonresidents for services performed in Yonkers; nonresident certifies on IT-2104.1; partial-year allocation by days

jurisdiction: MCTMT (Metropolitan Commuter Transportation Mobility Tax) - NYC counties (Zone 1) and 7 suburban counties (Zone 2)
rate_resident_pct: employer-paid; Zone 1 quarters from 2025-07-01: 0.055% / 0.115% / 0.60% / 0.895% by payroll bands (over $2.5M); Zone 2 0.055%-0.635% (see source)
source_date: page updated 2026-07-02; applies only if MCTD payroll over $312,500 per quarter
note: Zone 1 = Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens, Staten Island; Zone 2 = Rockland, Nassau, Suffolk, Orange, Putnam, Dutchess, Westchester
